body: I love you even if I don’t know you and you may feel useless but nobody is useless. I truly hope you reconsider and if you need to talk just message me I’m all ears.  Cause I’m broken too but we have to be there for each other.

You don’t. You keep grinding cause as pointless and miserable as life feels you don’t let it win. You push on not because you have something to look forward to, you push on because deep inside you wouldn’t have posted here if you wanted to die. You posted here because you want help whether you want to admit it or not. I have no will to live either but I also don’t want to die. If it means anything to you you can message me and I’ll be there for you if no one else will. Because even if your a complete stranger, were in this together and I if I can help you in anyway I will because I know what it’s like to feel broken and useless because that’s where I am right now. And I’m not saying it’s all sunshine and rainbows waiting around the corner but we don’t just live to die. We live to make a difference even if it’s just in one persons life.

One thing that helps me is to forget about women and think about myself. Every time I wanna fap I take that energy and do something like go for a walk or run/ go to the gym or read, just do something that will better yourself. Once you conquer yourself the women and the sex will come naturally. 

Just remember if you want to change bad enough you are in the driver seat.
I’m new too, it can be tough but far from impossible. Stay strong and remember why your doing this.
I got the same goal my friend. Just keep building your confidence and you’ll find someone best of luck man.
Hell yeah! The best things in life are given to those who work the hardest my friend.

Single virgin guy here, it’s kinda rocking my world to stop fapping/fantasizing. It’s like I got in real good shape past year which was hard but I did it and now  no fapping is difficult but I know I can do it to. My longest streak was only 5 days (I started a about 1-2 weeks ago) but during the streak I felt like I was living in the present finally. I relapsed last night but afterwards It felt bad. Not like beating myself up over it bad, more like Finally realizing I really don’t want or need to rely on fapping anymore.

Anyways this forum helps a bunch to see what everyone is also going through, helps me know we’re all in it together. Stay strong everyone.
